title: Whole Recurved Sand Spit and Open Bay
description: One newly authored whole stylised coastal landform: a broad raised mainland margin continues into a low narrow sand ridge that sweeps outward, curves back and ends in a free tapered hook. The sheltered inner bay remains openly connected to the surrounding flat sea-appearance surface through a broad unobstructed mouth. One continuous closed shared-vertex solid includes mainland, beach slopes, hook and all opaque water-coloured facets with one finite underside; no floating water plane or imported terrain mesh. This is not an enclosed horseshoe lake with a dry neck, or a standalone two-horn dune. Four constant matte PBR colours. One terrain model zero scenes. Static appearance only, no exact location, sediment processes, water flow/depth, tides, fluid simulation, navigation, collision, walkability or safety claim.
